build_scannet_data_loader: build a ScanNetData instance to load and manage ScanNet dataset splits like train, val, or test
get_scannet_infos: get data infos for all ScanNet scenes using get_infos with multithreaded processing and optional labels
get_aligned_bbox: get aligned bounding box labels for a ScanNet scene using get_aligned_box_label by sample index
get_camera_intrinsics: get camera intrinsic matrix for a ScanNet scene using get_intrinsics by sample index
get_camera_extrinsics: get camera extrinsic matrices for all poses in a ScanNet scene using get_extrinsics by sample index
